items.lede: The “Steal My Bitcoin” challenge offers a bounty to anyone who can breach a deliberately vulnerable PHP website using the recently disclosed PHP2Shell flaws. The challenge follows previous recoveries of locked Bitcoin fortunes through software vulnerabilities and AI-assisted investigation, but no successful claim has been confirmed.
items.title: Bitcoin reward offered to anyone who could break into an unpatched server running PHP, hacker cracks site and claims bounty

items.lede: Jaydip Modhwadia beats challenge designed to test real-world exploitability of PHP2Shell in around 3 hours
items.title: UK pentester 'killa' claims $2K Bitcoin prize in PHP2Shell capture-the-flag contest
